titel: Make blocky prints smooth in Blender ✨ #blender #3dprinting
printzin: Every printer is different: print a small test first.

scenes.tekst: Does your model look smooth in Blender, but blocky when you print it?
scenes.label: QUICK CHECK

scenes.tekst: Shade Smooth only changes how Blender draws it. Your slicer gets the flat faces.
scenes.label: WHY

scenes.tekst: Right click and pick Shade Flat to see what you will really print.
scenes.label: STEP 1

scenes.tekst: Those flat faces are what ends up in your print.
scenes.label: THE TRUTH
scenes.uitspraak: Those flat faces are what ends up in your print.

scenes.tekst: Open the Modifier properties and click Add Modifier.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: Hover over the modifier and press Ctrl A to apply it.
scenes.label: STEP 5
scenes.uitspraak: Hover over the modifier, and press Control A to apply it.

scenes.tekst: Now it looks round even with flat shading: 96 faces became 1,440 real faces.
scenes.label: ROUND
scenes.uitspraak: Now it looks round, even with flat shading. Ninety six faces became one thousand four hundred forty real faces.

scenes.tekst: It gets a little smaller, so check the size before you export.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: Every printer is different, so print a small test first. Save this for your next print.
scenes.label: PRINT FIRST

scenes.tekst: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
scenes.uitspraak: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
